conventions: glTF 2.0 binary. Y up, metres, +Z is the robot's front, origin on the floor at the centre of the base (arms) or between the feet (duck, humanoids). Posters: 1200x1200 WebP, transparent background, three-quarter view (35 deg azimuth, 15 deg elevation).
loader: All files use EXT_meshopt_compression (required): three.js GLTFLoader needs setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder) from three/examples/jsm/libs/meshopt_decoder.module.js; @react-three/drei useGLTF enables it by default. No Draco, no textures.

products.name: SO-101 Follower (MG996R)
products.notes: The app's existing SO-101 GLB (built from thenar-arms robot-studio/public/models/so101/study-manifest.json, sha256 39180f84…, commit 461f82d) with geometry and materials unchanged: 7 R3 printed units, 6 MG996R envelopes, 6 metal horns. Posed at the manifest HOME [0,-25,35,0,0,20] deg. Node tree is the joint tree: the six joint nodes (follower_shoulder_link … follower_moving_jaw_so101_v1_link) carry extras.joint 0–5 and rotate about their local +Z, as components/station/so101-arm.tsx drives them. Wrapped in a root node that maps the source mm Z-up frame to metres Y-up.

products.name: SO-101 Leader (passive AS5600, L1)
products.notes: Assembled from the repo's own manifest: all 73 leader instances (37 printed pieces, 36 purchased-part envelopes: 688 bearings, AS5600 PCB/chip/connectors, magnets) placed on the leader kinematic nodes exactly as the robot studio does, at HOME [0,-25,35,0,0,20] deg. Same recipe as the follower GLB (thenar-quest scripts/build-models.mjs): per-link merge by material, meshopt simplify to 45% (prints) / 60% (hardware), 35 deg creased normals; leader blue #5585df from the studio. docs/final_report.md records the SolidWorks leader master matching this forward kinematics to 5.8e-7 mm; the manifest itself still flags leader_pose_verified=false and the trigger's +15 deg mounting index as provisional. Joint nodes carry extras.joint 0–5 (local +Z), like the follower.

products.name: Thenar Duck (revision B)
products.notes: Source is the LFS review GLB (36.1 MB, 1,827,536 triangles, sha256 23e048a9…), mm, X forward/Y left/Z up, in its static review pose. It carries no materials (vertex colours are all white), so each of its 123 parts is coloured from the repo's reports/assembly_index.json (the colours its own renders use). Simplified with meshoptimizer within 0.08 mm (ST3215 vendor servo models, 82% of the source triangles, within 0.15 mm), 35 deg creased normals, merged per material (8 draw calls, no articulation). The source's labelled hardware envelopes (battery, PDB/UBEC/fuse capacity boxes, Pi connectors) are kept as-is. Origin is the centre of the two feet.

products.name: JX1 humanoid

source.path: simulation/meshes/source_mm/*.STL placed by tools/cad/leg_kinematics.py + tools/cad/upper_kinematics.py (link tree: simulation/mujoco/jx1.xml)

products.notes: All 87 exported SolidWorks part meshes (21 RobStride actuator housings + 21 outputs, 6061/7075 brackets, steel ankle cross/push-rods, torso, head, electronics) placed with the repo's own CAD kinematics, exactly as tools/media/assembly_film.py places them for the README hero renders; per-link frames were cross-checked against the MJCF body tree (all 24 match). Zero pose = straight-legged standing. Colours are the film's LOOK table (aluminium, black actuators, orange PETG-CF head, blue battery, green Jetson/hub). Node tree = MJCF bodies; each jointed node has extras {joint, axis, range(rad)}; link frames are world-aligned at zero pose. Battery, Jetson, hub board, DC-DC, switch, stereo camera and ST3215 body are box envelopes in the source CAD. No simplification needed (source 91,980 triangles).

products.name: JX0 small humanoid
products.notes: The 46 components of jx0/cad/assembly.json (the JX0_Robot.SLDASM placement: pose_mm + rotation matrix per component) using the exported part STLs: 12 ST3215 and 9 MG90S servo envelopes, printed PETG frame, orange head with GC9A01 display and face. Colours from jx0/cad/build_cad.py (the SolidWorks part colours; the cyan face gets a slight emissive). Merged per colour (5 draw calls, static). Origin is the centre of the two feet.
